searchText: Yes accounts are still permanent. but fundamentally storage slots take up more disk space and can extend infinitely for each account. Wouldn't it be sufficient if we focus on expiring just storage slots? IMO, 1. account data size is limited, and will increase slowly; 2. account data are first-class citizens, it’s worth in ecosystem friendly and user experience; here is the new version of the hybrid mode state expiry proposal, welcome to review & discuss~ https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/hybrid-mode-state-expiry/13068
